$comment: The OpenAPI generator that produces apps/mobile/lib/generated/api. scripts/openapi-generator.mjs downloads exactly this jar from Maven Central, refuses it unless its SHA-256 matches, and runs it with java. Change the version and the hash together, regenerate the client (pnpm dart-client) and keep openapitools.json at the same version. Maven Central publishes only md5/sha1 for the jar; the SHA-256 was computed from a download whose SHA-1 (b96b148fcf482808037f68fbad99cb4d7e65d40b) matched Maven's published .sha1.
